description: This file defines API endpoints related to repair management in a FastAPI application. It includes routes for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, assigning technicians, and changing the status of repairs, with role-based access control. The file also contains internal helper functions for role and permission checks.

classes.name: RepairService
classes.description: Service class handling core business logic for repair operations, such as creating, listing, updating, assigning technicians, and changing statuses.

methods.name: RepairService _svc()
methods.description: Private helper function to instantiate and return the RepairService.

methods.name: bool _has_role(user: CurrentUser, role: Role)
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific role.

methods.name: None _assert_can_view_repair(user: CurrentUser, repair: RepairRead)
methods.description: Verifies if a user is authorized to view a particular repair, raises HTTP 403 if not.

methods.name: RepairRead create_repair( payload: RepairCreate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.customer, Role.admin)), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new repair request by customers or admins.

methods.name: RepairsListResponse list_repairs(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to list repairs scoped to the user's role.

methods.name: RepairDetail get_repair_detail( repair_id: str, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve detailed information about a specific repair with access control.

methods.name: RepairRead patch_repair( repair_id: str, payload: RepairUpdate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: API endpoint to update fields of a repair, respecting role-based permissions.

methods.name: RepairRead assign_technician( repair_id: str, payload: RepairAssignRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), )
methods.description: Admin-only endpoint to assign a technician to a repair.

methods.name: RepairStatusHistoryItem change_repair_status( repair_id: str, payload: RepairStatusChangeRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to change the status of a repair, available to technicians assigned or admins.

ctags.signature: ( repair_id: str, payload: RepairAssignRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), )

ctags.name: change_repair_status
ctags.signature: ( repair_id: str, payload: RepairStatusChangeRequest, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.name: create_repair
ctags.signature: ( payload: RepairCreate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(require_role(Role.customer, Role.admin)), )

ctags.signature: ( repair_id: str, payload: RepairUpdate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user) )
